dashboards.name: DE ATENCIONES INSTITUCIONALES
dashboards.description: Este tablero muestra el promedio de casos de triage asignados y clasificados históricamente. Para la creacion de este tablero se hizo uso de la siguiente consulta: SELECT DIM_TRIAGE.OID AS 'OID_TRIAGE', DIM_TRIAGE.GPADOCUME, DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO, DIM_TRIAGE.GPANOMBRE, DIM_TRIAGE.GPASEGNOM, DIM_TRIAGE.GPAAPELLI, DIM_TRIAGE.GPASEGAPE, DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE, DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI, CASE WHEN DIM_HCNCONTRDT.HCCFECTUR IS NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), HCTFECTRI, 103)+' '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), HCTFECTRI, 114) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), DIM_HCNCONTRDT.HCCFECTUR, 103)+' '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DIM_HCNCONTRDT.HCCFECTUR, 114) END 'LLEGADA_PORTERO', CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI,103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI,114) AS FECHA_TRIAGE, CASE WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'I' THEN 'I' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'I-G' THEN 'EMERGENCIA OBSTETRICA' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'II' THEN 'II' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'II-G' THEN 'URGENCIA MEDICA OBSTETRICA' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'III' THEN 'III' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'III-G' THEN 'URGENCIA OBSTETRICA' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IIIU' THEN 'III' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IIP' THEN 'II' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IIS' THEN 'II' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IV' THEN 'IV' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IV-G' THEN 'NO URGENTE OBSTETRICA' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'M' THEN 'MUERTO' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'V' THEN 'V' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'V-G' THEN 'CONSULTA EXTERNA OBSTETRICA' END 'DESCRI_TRIGE', CASE WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'I' THEN 'I' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'I-G' THEN 'I-G' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'II' THEN 'II' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'II-G' THEN 'II-G' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'III' THEN 'III' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'III-G' THEN 'III-G' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IIIU' THEN 'III' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IIP' THEN 'II' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IIS' THEN 'II' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IV' THEN 'IV' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'IV-G' THEN 'IV-G' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'M' THEN 'MUERTO' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'V' THEN 'V' WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'V-G' THEN 'V-G' END 'CLASIFICACION_TRIAGE', DATEPART(HOUR, DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) AS HORA, FORMAT( --CASE --WHEN --DATEPART(MINUTE, DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) < 30 THEN DATEADD(MINUTE, -DATEPART(MINUTE, DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI), DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) --ELSE -- DATEADD(MINUTE, 30 - DATEPART(MINUTE, DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI), DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) --END , 'hh:mm tt') AS TramoHorario, CASE WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=2 THEN '1. LUNES' WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=3 THEN '2. MARTES' WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=4 THEN '3. MIÉRCOLES' WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=5 THEN '4. JUEVES' WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=6 THEN '5. VIERNES' WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=7 THEN '6. SÁBADO' WHEN DATEPART(DW,DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI)=1 THEN '7. DOMINGO' end DIA_SEMANA, CASE WHEN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO = 'I' THEN 2 ELSE DATEDIFF(MI,DIM_HCNCONTRDT.HCCFECTUR, DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) END AS 'MIN', YEAR(DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) AÑO, MONTH(DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI) MES, CASE WHEN DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE LIKE '%NUEVA%' THEN 'NUEVA EPS' WHEN DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE LIKE '%SURA%' AND DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE NOT LIKE '%SEGUROS DE VIDA SURA%' AND DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE NOT LIKE '%SURAMERICANA%' THEN 'SURA' WHEN DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE LIKE '%SANITAS%' AND DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE NOT LIKE '%COLSANITAS%' AND DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE NOT LIKE '%MEDISANITAS%' THEN 'SANITAS' WHEN DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE LIKE '%MALLAMAS%' THEN 'MALLAMAS' ELSE DIM_ENTIDAD.ENTNOMBRE END ASEGURADORA ,CAST(DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI AS DATE) FECHA ,DIM_ENTIDAD.GENTERCER1 ,CASE WHEN HCTEDAD <18 THEN 'MENORES DE EDAD' ELSE 'MAYORES DE EDAD' END MENORES ,DIM_ENTIDAD.OID OID_ASEGURADORA ,GENTERCER_DW.TERNOMCOM --,AdmisionTriage.Oid FROM DIM_TRIAGE LEFT OUTER JOIN DIM_ENTIDAD ON DIM_ENTIDAD.OID = DIM_TRIAGE.GEENENTADM INNER JOIN DIM_HCNCLAURGTR ON DIM_TRIAGE.HCNCLAURGTR = DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.OID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIM_HCNCONTRDT ON DIM_HCNCONTRDT.OID = DIM_TRIAGE.HCNCONTRDT LEFT JOIN GENTERCER_DW ON DIM_ENTIDAD.GENTERCER1=GENTERCER_DW.OID --LEFT JOIN PLANILLAUSUARIO.DBO.ADMISIONTRIAGE ON AdmisionTriage.Documento=DIM_TRIAGE.GPADOCUME AND CAST(AdmisionTriage.HoraEntrada AS date)= CAST(DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI AS DATE) AND DIM_TRIAGE.GEENENTADM=AdmisionTriage.Aseguradora WHERE DIM_HCNCLAURGTR.HCCODIGO NOT IN ('UA') AND CAST(DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) ORDER BY DIM_TRIAGE.HCTFECTRI Medidas usadas en este tablero: Promedio del triage en 2025: PROMEDIO_TRIAGE_2025 = CALCULATE( AVERAGE(OPORTUNIDAD_TRIAGE[MIN]), YEAR(OPORTUNIDAD_TRIAGE[FECHA]) = 2025 ) Promedio del triage en 2026: PROMEDIO_TRIAGE_2026 = CALCULATE( AVERAGE(OPORTUNIDAD_TRIAGE[MIN]), YEAR(OPORTUNIDAD_TRIAGE[FECHA]) = 2026 )
